correctness.rationale: The symplectic Euler-quotient exact sequence is surjective because a five-space cannot be isotropic in a nondegenerate six-dimensional symplectic space. The intrinsic splitting of Ω²(2) on each twisted cubic is O(-2)^3+O(-1)^6+O. Nonisotropic annihilators split the quotient. For isotropic annihilators π sharp maps the two-dimensional annihilator injectively into the cubic span, forcing the six cross-term linear coefficients to be basepoint-free; hence the H0 map to O(1) has full rank 2 and h0(E|C(-2))=6. Together with h0(E|C(-3))=0 or 1, global generation of E and E dual twisted by O(1), rank nine and degree fifteen, the displayed splitting types follow uniquely. The Plücker isotropy equation cuts the smooth codimension-one IG(2,6) divisor. Exact rational checks cover all 15 coordinate spans without treating them as universal proof.

originality.rationale: The new statement is an all-smooth-twisted-cubic, exact two-splitting-type theorem and symplectic jump divisor, absent from the inspected primary six-page Denham–Miró-Roig–Schenck paper and the strong older Landsberg–Manivel §6.2 source. Dual twist relation to the older source is explicitly identified. Prior accessible own records classify rank-four bivector jumping lines, symplectic bundle restrictions to projective planes, or its Fano projectivization, not twisted-cubic restriction types. Targeted published-finding corpus searches returned no equivalent or stronger cubic-specific result. Novelty is qualified by the residual risk that a general symplectic construction elsewhere may implicitly yield it.
residual_risks: The earlier Landsberg–Manivel symplectic presentation is equivalent to the dual twist of the present bundle. This source is deliberately compared; the precise twisted-cubic splitting theorem was not found there but an unstated derivation cannot be categorically excluded.
The classification covers only smooth twisted cubics over the complex numbers and makes no scheme-theoretic assertion for a nonreduced Hilbert jumping locus.
A finite script checks examples and not the infinitely many curves; the universal result rests on the proof in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: The complete restriction classification of the first nonplanar rational-normal-curve degree for a uniform nonhomogeneous bundle gives an exact geometric test invisible on lines and distinct from plane/conic restrictions. The codimension-one IG(2,6) locus is a natural, nonempty smooth jump divisor with a cohomological and symplectic interpretation, relevant to moduli and rational curve geometry; both splitting types are realized. This is a motivated structural refinement rather than a random coordinate experiment.
